defect.reason: EMAC_B dual-accumulation operations are no-load MAAAC/MASAC/MSAAC/MSSAC instructions. MAC-with-load has one destination accumulator.
defect.reference: NXP ColdFire Family Programmer's Reference Manual, Rev. 3, Chapter 6

after_decoder_fix.interpretation: The first transform now propagates the low Sample Slot lane instead of canceling it.

downstream_write.conclusion: The EMAC low lane is repaired. A separate packed-transform stage now owns the final clearing write.

local_validation.minicoldfire_regression: MAC-with-load accumulates once into ACC1 and loads D0

next_step.name: AR172_QEMU_PACKED_SAMPLE_LANE_GATE
next_step.objective: Trace the 13-by-21 packed transform at 0x4011C69E..0x4011C6E4 and identify which input bit/byte should preserve the Sample Slot field at 0x8000F7CE.

qwerty_milestone: Once the native sample consumer passes, map QWERTY key-down/up to the validated panel press/release frames.

github_actions.policy: Validate locally and publish with [skip ci].

safety: No firmware, extracted MAIN, project data, sample names, descriptor slabs, or proprietary PCM are included. Trace-only interventions remain outside the repository.
